notes.overview: A 3.167 km, 11-turn street circuit on the Long Beach waterfront, lined with concrete walls. The lap is defined by the long, slightly curved Shoreline Drive front straight: the slow Hairpin (T11) feeds it, and the heavy stop for T1 ends it. The back straight runs along Seaside Way under the Convention Center footbridge into T9.

corners.1: The end of Shoreline Drive: the heaviest braking zone on the lap and the main overtaking spot.
corners.2: The Fountain, first part. Slow and tight around the fountain.
corners.3: The Fountain, second part. T3 to T5 wrap around the aquarium car park.
corners.5: The exit onto the run that parallels Shoreline Drive.
corners.6: Braking while dropping downhill into the corner.
corners.8: Sharp right onto Seaside Way and the back straight.
corners.9: A 90-degree right at the end of the Seaside Way back straight, after the Convention Center footbridge.
corners.10: A sweeping, roughly 135-degree left past the grandstands that runs straight into the braking zone for the Hairpin.
corners.11: The Hairpin: the slowest corner (barely 30 mph in an IndyCar). The exit sets the speed for the whole of Shoreline Drive.

notes.source: Wikipedia (Long Beach Street Circuit); NBC LA course map; IMSA (Long Beach hairpin); Driving Line (Formula Drift T9-T11). Paraphrased.
